value.rationale: Exact classification of every minimum attractor for a natural infinite word family, full-length multiplicity generating function, and a robust mean–typical divergence (uniqueness probability tends to one but expected minimizers tend to 5/2) provide a motivated structural statistic beyond routine minimum-size determination. The rare singleton-middle-run mechanism is exact and general for this family.
